description: What the US government obligated to a company in a fiscal year, no key: the total, by agency and industry code, its recipient entities, and its largest contracts with links, from USAspending.gov.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name; its SEC name is searched ("LOCKHEED MARTIN").

fiscal_year.description: US federal fiscal year (October to September); default the last complete one.

recipients.description: Or recipient names to search instead, e.g. a subsidiary ["Sikorsky"].

name: federal_contracts

outputSchema.description: Dollar obligations in the fiscal year; each table's rows in the order of its columns.

title: Federal contracts (USAspending)
